title: day2 making 3d space snakes game
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
so because of yesterdays feedback , decided to invest time into this concept to make a playable version from it !!!!

not sure about theme yet 100%  ,  not sure how i will implement multiplayer just yet ,  will launch the offline version after this weekend for a week to gather more feedback first 

thinking of calling it spacesnakes    or spaceworms   
not sure either   BUT ANYWAYS 

this is 100% inspired by [slith.io](http://slith.io) and watching space games started with this  concept  yesterday  
   
since i wanted to experience how it would feel having no axis movement limitations 

So far i have gained so much insight from yesterdays video , i made a list of great ideas im going to play around with this weekend 

so what i did in the small time frame i had today was   
1 set up a settings mode (where you can set culling distant orbs or keep it limitless)  
=   when culling distant and fading them , it cuts down 70/75%   primitive draw calls to the gpu   
  
movement velocity reduced slightly for better turning movement   
  
added more distinct orb shader to defeated snakes dropped orbs  

added a defeated snake shader making shem desolve into orbs 

OH and i figured out a draw call ordering bug that made snake distance perception difficult to measure   




  
well guys will keep you all posted   
and thank you for all yesterdays feedback !!!
